article: Githubリポジトリにカスタムドメインを設定する方法
findings: Preserved the original 2022-09-13 date, removed the conflicting injected 2026 date, and set lastmod 2026-11-23 in all editions.
Replaced registrar-specific Onamae.com walkthrough and affiliate tracking pixels with provider-neutral GitHub Pages setup instructions.
Updated DNS propagation estimate from 72 hours to GitHub’s current up-to-24-hour guidance; added domain verification before setup and the order to register with Pages before changing DNS.
Added current apex A/optional AAAA and ALIAS/ANAME guidance, www CNAME target, wildcard-DNS caution, Windows/Linux DNS checks, HTTPS provisioning, and branch-versus-Actions CNAME behavior.
scope: Read the full Japanese article and all twelve translations. Checked current official GitHub Pages guidance, domain security, DNS records and addresses, verification order, propagation, HTTPS, and publishing workflow notes.

meaning.note: Read the complete Japanese article and complete localized edition. Compared domain verification order, repository Pages setup, DNS record options, apex/www behavior, propagation guidance, HTTPS provisioning, and publishing-source differences.

terminology.note: Checked localized terminology for apex domain, A/AAAA/CNAME/ALIAS/ANAME records, DNS propagation, custom-domain verification, certificate provisioning, branch publishing, and GitHub Actions.

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical claims or calculations.

code.note: Reviewed the DNS table and dig/Resolve-DnsName commands, all listed GitHub Pages IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, host placeholders, record types, and CNAME target. No DNS changes or commands against a real domain were performed.

links.note: Checked five official GitHub Pages documents covering supported custom domains, DNS management, ownership verification, HTTPS, and troubleshooting.
